blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Quantitative characterization of lymph node morphology is important for assessing axillary lymph node metastasis in breast cancer. However, surfaces reconstructed from computed tomography (CT) segmentation may contain geometric and topological defects that compromise subsequent analysis, while conventional shape descriptors predominantly characterize global morphology. To address these issues, we developed an integrated framework combining topology-aware surface processing with multi-resolution spherical harmonic (SH) analysis of CT-derived axillary lymph nodes. The processing pipeline produced topology-valid genus-0 surfaces with improved mesh quality, which were then represented at multiple SH degrees and characterized using 20 predefined geometric feature families. Geometric fidelity increased with SH degree, whereas predictive performance peaked at intermediate resolutions, indicating that maximal reconstruction fidelity did not coincide with maximal discriminative utility. Preferred SH degree also differed across feature families. A family-specific mixed-resolution model achieved an AUC of 0.918 (95% CI, 0.904–0.934), compared with 0.884 (95% CI, 0.868–0.900) for the conventional PyRadiomics Shape14 baseline, corresponding to an improvement of 0.0344 (95% paired bootstrap CI, 0.0212–0.0468). Controlled perturbation experiments showed that higher SH degrees transmitted more fine-scale geometric variation and yielded lower stability of curvature-based predictions. Representative geometric descriptors provided interpretable characterization of metastasis-associated surface morphology. Independent validation further supported the transportability of the framework: label-free replication in a multicenter lymph node cohort reproduced the family-specific resolution effects, while a labeled LIDC-IDRI lung-nodule experiment reproduced the resolution-dependent relationship between SH degree and predictive performance. Altogether, the proposed framework provides a topology-valid basis for multi-scale quantitative characterization of lymph node morphology and metastasis-associated imaging phenotypes.
blocks.zh: 淋巴结形态学的定量定性对于评估乳腺癌中的轴突淋巴结元化作用十分重要. 然而,通过计算成的成像图(CT)片段重建的表面可能含有几何和地形缺陷,这些缺陷影响了随后的分析,而常规的形状描述器则主要是全球形态特征的特征。 为了解决这些问题,我们开发了一个综合框架,将地貌-感知表面处理与CT衍生的轴突淋巴结的多分辨率球形声波(SH)分析结合起来。 加工管道产生了地形-验证的基因-0表面,网格质量得到提高,然后以多SH度表示,并使用20个预先定义的几何特征家族进行特征描述. 几何忠诚度随着SH程度的提高而增加,而预测性能则在中间分辨率时达到顶峰,表明最大限度的重建忠诚度与最大限度的歧视性效用并不相吻合。 首选的SH学位也因特色家庭而异。 一个针对家庭的混合分辨率模型实现了0.918的AUC(95%CI,0.904–0.934),而传统的PyRadiomics shape14基线则为0.884(95%配对的靴子CI,0.0212–0.0468). 受控扰动实验显示,较高的SH度传递了更多的细度几何变异,并产生了较低的曲率预测稳定性. 具有代表性的几何描述符提供了元数据相关表面形态的可解释特征。 独立验证进一步支持了框架的可运输性:在多中心淋巴结组中无标签复制复制了家庭特异性分辨率效应,而标注的LIDC-IDRI肺鼻实验则复制了SH度与预测性能之间的依赖分辨率关系. 总而言之,拟议框架为淋巴结形态学和元史相关成像苯基类的多尺度定量定性提供了地形验证基础。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Axillary lymph node metastasis is a key component of regional staging in breast cancer and has important implications for locoregional treatment planning and prognosis ( Marino et al., 2020 ) . Quantitative imaging and radiomics provide a means of characterizing disease-related phenotypes beyond qualitative visual assessment ( Lambin et al., 2017 ) , and CT-derived lymph node features have demonstrated predictive value for metastatic status in both single-center and multicenter studies ( Yang et al., 2021 ; Qu et al., 2024 ; Qu et al., 2025 ) . In clinical imaging, metastatic lymph nodes may exhibit cortical thickening, focal cortical bulging, loss of the fatty hilum, and a transition from an oval or reniform shape toward a round, asymmetric, or irregular contour. These morphological changes may reflect partial or diffuse replacement of the nodal architecture by metastatic tumor, with capsular invasion and extranodal extension occurring in more advanced nodal involvement ( Dialani et al., 2018 ) .
However, lymph node morphology is commonly represented by image-derived radiomic variables or a limited set of global shape descriptors describing size, compactness, principal-axis geometry, and spatial extent. Such measurements may obscure localized or asymmetric changes and provide limited characterization of local surface geometry, symmetry, and spatially heterogeneous three-dimensional morphology. Metastatic involvement may alter nodal morphology in a spatially heterogeneous manner, producing asymmetric enlargement, focal contour bulging, lobulation, or contour irregularity that may not be fully reflected by global measurements of size, elongation, or compactness.
blocks.zh:
轴淋巴结元病是乳腺癌地区发病的关键组成部分,对地区治疗规划和预后有重要影响(圣马力诺等人,2020年)。 定量成像和放射学为定性视觉评估以外的与疾病有关的酚类提供了一种定性手段(Lambin等人,2017年),CT衍生淋巴结特征在单中心研究和多中心研究中都证明了元静态的预测值(Yang等人,2021年;Qu等人,2024年;Qu等人,2025年)。 在临床成像中,元静脉淋巴结可能呈现皮质增厚,焦质皮质膨胀,肥厚的脚踝丧失,从椭圆形或复形向圆形,不对称或不规则轮廓过渡. 这些形态变化可能反映节点结构被元静态肿瘤部分或扩散取代,在更高级的节点参与中发生圆顶入侵和节点外延伸(Dialani等人,2018年).
然而,淋巴节点形态通常以图像衍生的放射变量或有限一组描述大小,紧凑度,主轴几何,空间范围的全球形状描述符来代表. 这种测量可能模糊局部或不对称的变化,对局部地表几何、对称和空间多样性的三维形态进行有限的定性。 元静态参与可能以空间多样性的方式改变节点形态,产生不对称的膨胀、焦距膨胀、隆起或轮廓不规则,而这种不规则可能无法从大小、延长或紧凑性的全球测量中充分反映出来。

blocks.en:
Explicit surface analysis introduces an additional computational requirement: meshes reconstructed from CT-derived lymph node segmentations must provide a numerically and topologically valid domain for subsequent geometric operators. Limited spatial resolution, anisotropic voxel sampling, segmentation boundaries, and surface reconstruction can introduce staircase artifacts, local geometric irregularities, disconnected structures, and topological inconsistencies ( Škrinjar and Bistoquet, 2009 ; Mönch et al., 2011 ; Ito, 2019 ; Shirshin et al., 2021 ) . Existing smoothing and topology-repair techniques address individual failure modes ( Taubin, 1995 ; Desbrun et al., 1999 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , but smoothing alone does not guarantee a valid spherical domain, and genus alone does not ensure connectedness, closedness, manifoldness, or consistent orientation. SH-based reconstruction has also been explored for correcting topological defects
in medically derived surface meshes, particularly for cortical surfaces ( Yotter et al., 2009 ) . Reliable surface-based analysis therefore requires coordinated control of geometric artifacts, topology, mesh quality, and geometric preservation.
blocks.zh:
明晰的表面分析引入了一个额外的计算要求:从CT衍生淋巴结分解中重建的中间体必须为后续几何操作者提供数字和地形上有效的域. 空间分辨率有限,异同位素吸盘采样,分界,地表重建可以引入楼梯文物,局部几何不规则,断裂结构,以及地形不一致(Škrinjar and Bistoquet,2009年;Mönch等人,2011年;Ito,2019年;Shirshin等人,2021年). 现有的平滑和地形修复技术涉及个人故障模式(Taubin,1995年;Desbrun等人,1995年)。 1999; Chen et al., 2025),但光靠平滑并不能保证一个有效的球形域,光是基因并不能保证连接性,闭合性,多面性,或者一致的方向. 还探索了基于自助的重建,以纠正地形缺陷
在医学上衍生的表面膜中,特别是皮质表面(Yotter等人,2009年)。 因此,可靠的地表分析需要对几何文物、地形、网状质量和几何保护进行协调一致的控制。

blocks.en: Once a valid genus- 0 0 surface has been obtained, spherical parameterization provides a natural common domain for representing and comparing three-dimensional geometry ( Choi et al., 2015 ; Lyu et al., 2024 ) . Spherical harmonics (SH) are particularly well suited to this setting because they provide an ordered spectral representation in which surface geometry can be reconstructed at progressively increasing spatial resolutions ( Brechbühler et al., 1995 ; Styner et al., 2006 ; Khairy and Howard, 2008 ) . Recent work has further investigated improved SH sampling and reconstruction strategies for general three-dimensional shape representation ( Li et al., 2024 ) . Low harmonic degrees primarily encode coarse, large-scale morphology, whereas higher degrees progressively recover finer geometric structure. SH therefore provide two complementary advantages for quantitative surface analysis: a compact representation of genus- 0 0 geometry and an explicit mechanism for controlling the spatial scale at which morphology is represented.
blocks.zh: 一旦获得有效的基因-0表面,球形参数化为代表并比较三维几何提供了自然的常见域(Choi等人,2015年;Lyu等人,2024年). 球形口琴(SH)特别适合这种设置,因为它们提供了有序的光谱表示,其中表面几何可以以逐渐增加的空间分辨率进行重建(Brechbühler等人,1995年;Styner等人,2006年;Khairy和Howard,2008年)。 最近的工作进一步调查了改进的一般三维形状代表的SH取样和重建战略(Li等人,2024年)。 低谐波度主要编码粗糙,大规模形态,而较高度则逐渐恢复更细的几何结构. 因此,SH为定量表面分析提供了两个互补的优势:精密的格子-0几何的表示,以及用于控制形态的空间尺度的明确机制.

blocks.en: SH-derived representations have previously been used for medical shape classification, including three-dimensional lung-nodule malignancy analysis and myocardial-infarction screening ( El-Baz et al., 2011 ; Valizadeh et al., 2021 ) . However, these studies primarily used SH-derived representations or coefficients as predictive shape information rather than systematically examining how the finite reconstruction bandwidth influences downstream geometric measurements. This scale dependence raises a central methodological question: the SH degree required for faithful geometric reconstruction need not be the degree that most effectively represents morphology associated with metastatic status. Increasing the maximum harmonic degree expands representational capacity and improves the recovery of fine surface detail, but the additional high-frequency information may contain both disease-related morphology and variation that is only weakly associated with the clinical endpoint. Conversely, truncation at a lower or intermediate degree may suppress fine-scale variation while preserving larger-scale morphological organization. Geometric fidelity and discriminative utility are therefore distinct properties of an SH representation, and optimizing one does not necessarily optimize the other. Resolution may also influence robustness, because higher SH degrees can retain finer geometric perturbations arising from segmentation uncertainty, reconstruction artifacts, or other small surface variations, whereas spectral truncation may attenuate such perturbations. SH degree can therefore be viewed not only as a reconstruction parameter but also as a candidate geometric scale governing the balance among geometric fidelity, discriminative information, and sensitivity to perturbation.
blocks.zh: 以往SH衍生的表示法被用于医学形状分类,包括三维肺鼻炎分析和心肌梗塞筛查(El-Baz等人,2011年;Valizadeh等人,2021年). 然而,这些研究主要使用SH衍生的表示或系数作为预测形状信息,而不是系统地审查有限重建带宽如何影响下游几何测量。 这种规模依赖性提出了一个核心方法问题:忠实几何重建所需的SH学位不一定是最能有效代表与元静态相关的形态学的学位. 增加最大谐波度可以扩大代表能力,改善精细表面细节的恢复,但额外的高频信息可能同时包含与疾病相关的形态学和与临床终点只有微弱关联的变异. 相反,低度或中度的切变可能抑制细度的变异,同时保留较大的形态组织. 因此,几何忠诚和歧视性效用是SH代表的独特特性,优化一种不一定优化另一种。 分辨率还可能影响稳健性,因为较高的SH度可以保留因分化不确定性、重建文物或其他微小的表面变化而形成的更细微的几何扰动,而光谱截断则可以减轻这种扰动。 因此,SH学位不仅可被视为重建参数,而且可视为可选几何尺度,用以规范几何忠诚度、歧视性信息和对扰动的敏感性之间的平衡。

blocks.en: The appropriate geometric scale may further depend on the quantity being measured. Conventional three-dimensional shape features, such as those defined in the PyRadiomics framework, primarily summarize global size, principal-axis geometry, compactness, and surface-to-volume relationships ( van Griethuysen et al., 2017 ) . Differential-geometric descriptors characterize local surface bending and shape type ( Meyer et al., 2003 ; Koenderink and van Doorn, 1992 ) ; Laplace–Beltrami spectra and diffusion-based signatures characterize intrinsic geometry across multiple scales ( Reuter et al., 2006 ; Sun et al., 2009 ; Aubry et al., 2011 ) ; geodesic measures describe intrinsic spatial extent ( Crane et al., 2013 ) ; and shape-distribution and symmetry descriptors capture complementary aspects of three-dimensional spatial organization ( Osada et al., 2001 ; Kazhdan et al., 2004 ) . Because these descriptors depend on different geometric properties and spatial neighborhoods, there is little reason to expect a single SH degree to represent all feature families equally effectively. A uniformly low resolution may suppress information required by locally sensitive descriptors, whereas a uniformly high resolution may retain fine-scale variation that contributes little to more global measurements or to discrimination. This motivates a feature-dependent treatment of reconstruction scale rather than the assumption of a universally optimal SH degree.
blocks.zh: 适当的几何尺度可能进一步取决于所测量的数量。 常规三维形状特征,如PyRadiomics框架中定义的特征,主要概括了全球大小,主轴几何,紧凑度,以及地表对体积的关系(van Griethuysen等人,2017年). 地方地表弯曲和形状类型的不同地理特征特征(Meyer等人,2003年;Koenderink和van Doorn,1992年);Laplace-Beltrami光谱和基于扩散的特征特征为多个尺度的内在几何特征特征(Reuter等人,2006年;Sun等人,2009年;Aubry等人,2011年);大地测量测量尺度描述内在空间范围(Crane等人,2013年);以及形状分布和对称性特征特征描述,捕捉三维空间组织的补充方面(Osada等人,2001年;Kazhdan等人,2004年)。 由于这些描述词依赖于不同的几何属性和空间邻里,因此没有什么理由期望一个单一的SH学位同样有效地代表所有特征家庭. 统一低分辨率可能会压制当地敏感描述符所要求的信息,而统一高分辨率可能会保留细度的变异,对更全球性的测量或歧视作用不大。 这促使对重建规模进行以特点为依据的处理,而不是假设具有普遍的最佳自助程度。

blocks.en: In this study, we develop an integrated framework for topology-aware processing and multi-resolution geometric analysis of CT-derived axillary lymph node surfaces. We first establish a processing workflow that combines context-aware smoothing, adaptive topology correction, geometry-constrained smoothing, and local artifact reconstruction, and evaluate the resulting surfaces in terms of topological validity and computational quality. We then examine SH representations across multiple harmonic degrees to determine how reconstruction resolution affects geometric fidelity, spectral discrimination, and predictive performance. Geometric descriptors are organized into predefined feature families to evaluate feature-dependent resolution preferences and construct a family-specific mixed-resolution representation. Resolution-dependent robustness is further assessed through geometric perturbation transmission, harmonic-domain perturbation energy, and downstream predictive stability. Finally, independent multicenter lymph node and cross-organ LIDC-IDRI experiments are used to assess transportability of the observed geometric and resolution-dependent effects.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们开发了一个综合框架,用于对CT衍生的轴突淋巴结表面进行地形意识处理和多分辨率几何分析。 我们首先建立集上下文感光平滑,适应性地形校正,几何约束平滑,局部文物重建为一体的加工工作流程,从地形有效性和计算质量角度评价所产生的表面. 然后,我们审查跨多个谐波度的SH表达,以确定重建分辨率如何影响几何忠诚、光谱歧视和预测性能。 几何描述符被组织成预先定义的特征家族,以评估依赖特征的解析偏好,并构建一个针对家庭的混合解析代表. 通过几何扰动传输、谐振域扰动能量和下游预测稳定性,进一步评估依赖分辨率的稳健性。 最后,独立的多中心淋巴结和跨器官LIDC-IDRI实验被用来评估观测到的几何和分辨率依赖效应的可运输性.

blocks.en: 2 Data and geometric processing of lymph node surfaces
blocks.zh: 2淋巴结表面的数据和几何处理

blocks.en: 2.1 Study cohort and input data
blocks.zh: 2.1 学习组群和输入数据

blocks.en: The CT-derived lymph node label maps analyzed in this study were obtained from previously reported datasets ( Qu et al., 2024 ; Qu et al., 2025 ) . Specifically, the published Semi-ALNP cohort included 214 women with unilateral invasive breast cancer who underwent preoperative high-resolution thin-section contrast-enhanced CT and axillary lymph node dissection (ALND). The main eligibility criteria were the absence of distant metastasis and no neoadjuvant therapy before imaging. Briefly, individual axillary lymph nodes were delineated on consecutive thin-slice contrast-enhanced CT images. CT was performed within 1 month before surgery using a high-resolution thin-section contrast-enhanced protocol, with a 1-mm reconstructed slice thickness and 0-mm spacing. Histopathological examination of the ALND specimens served as the reference standard. The labels were defined using two patient groups: 1,769 ALNs from 214 patients, including 1,172 ALNs from 161 patients with no nodal metastasis and 597 ALNs from 53 patients in whom all dissected ALNs were metastatic. In the earlier dataset, three-dimensional lymph node localization was assisted by VitaWorks, followed by segmentation in 3D Slicer. In the subsequent Semi-ALNP dataset, ALNs were segmented in ITK-SNAP v3.8.0 using a region-growing procedure by two independent operators who were blinded to clinical and pathological information. The segmentations were subsequently reviewed and finalized by a senior radiologist. These procedures yielded complete three-dimensional lymph node label volumes.
blocks.zh: 本研究分析的CT衍生淋巴结标签图来自以前报告的数据集(Qu等人,2024年;Qu等人,2025年)。 具体地说,出版的《半国家利比里亚国家警察》包括214名患单方面侵入性乳腺癌的妇女,她们接受了术前高分辨率的薄剖面对比增强症(CT)和轴淋巴结分解症(ALND)。 主要的合格标准是没有远程元化药物,在成像前没有新朱vant疗法. 简而言之,单个轴突淋巴结是在连续的薄片对比增强的CT图像上划定的。 CT在手术前1个月内使用高分辨率的薄剖面对比增强协议进行,1毫米重建的切片厚度和0毫米间距. 对ALND标本的病理学检查是参考标准。 标签使用两个病人群体来界定:214个病人的1 769个民族解放军,包括161个节点元化病人的1 172个民族解放军,53个病人的597个民族解放军,其中所有解剖的民族解放军都是元化的。 在早期的数据集中,三维淋巴结局部化得到了VitaWorks的协助,之后在3D Slicer中进行分解. 在随后的Semi-ALNP数据集中,ALN在ITK-SNAP v3.8.0中采用区域增殖程序,由两个独立的操作者进行分解,他们看不到临床和病理信息。 随后,一名高级放射学家审查并最后确定了这些分区。 这些程序产生了完整的三维淋巴结标签卷。

blocks.en: An independent multicenter external-validation cohort was retrospectively collected from four hospitals between January 2023 and July 2024 ( Qu et al., 2025 ) . The external dataset comprised CT-derived three-dimensional axillary lymph node label maps from patients with breast cancer. Individual CT-visible lymph nodes in this cohort were not linked to node-level histopathological metastasis labels; therefore, metastatic status was unavailable for the external surfaces included in the present analysis. An additional cross-organ validation experiment was performed using segmented lung nodules from the publicly available LIDC-IDRI dataset ( Armato III et al., 2011 ) . After application of the predefined surface-availability and analysis criteria, 59 lung nodules with corresponding classification labels were retained. This cohort was analyzed independently from the axillary lymph node datasets to examine whether the relationship between SH reconstruction degree and predictive performance was preserved in a distinct anatomical structure and downstream classification task. The LIDC-IDRI data were not used for the development of the lymph node prediction models, the selection of lymph node feature families, or the determination of the SH degrees examined in the primary analysis.
blocks.zh: 2023年1月至2024年7月期间,从四家医院(Qu等人,2025年)收回了一个独立的多中心外部鉴定组。 外部数据集包括来自乳腺癌患者的CT三维轴淋巴结标签图。 本组中单个CT可见淋巴结与节点级组织病理元化标签没有关联;因此,本分析中包含的外部表面没有元化状态. 利用公开的LIDC-IDRI数据集的分块肺结核进行了另一个跨器官验证实验(Armato III等人,2011年)。 在适用预先确定的表层可用性和分析标准后,保留了59个具有相应分类标签的肺结核。 这个组别是从轴式淋巴节点数据集中独立分析出来的,以审查SH重建程度与预测性能之间的关系是否在一个明显的解剖结构和下游分类任务中得以保留. LIDC-IDRI数据没有用于开发淋巴节点预测模型,选择淋巴节点特征家族,或者确定主分析中检查的SH度.

blocks.en: For all cohorts, the resulting NIfTI label maps were converted into triangular surface meshes using a smoothing factor of 0.2 0.2 . This setting provided mild suppression of voxel-scale irregularities while limiting excessive surface deformation and the introduction of additional geometric artifacts.
blocks.zh: 对所有组群,产生的NIfTI标签地图被转换成三角表面网点,使用0.20.2的平滑系数. 这种环境轻度抑制了排毒量级的违规行为,同时限制了过度的表面变形和引进更多的几何文物。

blocks.en: 2.2 Overview of the geometric processing workflow
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 几何处理工作流程概览

blocks.en: The reconstructed lymph node surfaces were processed using the sequential geometric workflow illustrated in Fig. 1 . The workflow was designed to suppress segmentation- and reconstruction-related artifacts, enforce the topological requirements for spherical parameterization, and improve local mesh quality while limiting unnecessary modification of the underlying surface geometry.
blocks.zh: 重建的淋巴结表面采用图1所示的顺序几何工作流程进行处理。 该工作流程旨在压制与分化和重建相关的文物,执行球形参数化的地形要求,提高局部网格质量,同时限制对基础表面几何进行不必要的修改.

blocks.en: The initial meshes underwent context-aware smoothing to attenuate staircase artifacts, followed by adaptive voxelization with strict topology validation. At each candidate voxel-grid resolution, natural voxelization was evaluated before explicit topology repair. A naturally voxelized surface was accepted whenever it satisfied all predefined validity criteria. Explicit topology repair was invoked only when no naturally valid candidate was available, and a convex-hull-based reconstruction was retained as a final fallback when necessary. A second context-aware smoothing stage was then applied to attenuate staircase-like irregularities introduced or retained during voxelization.

blocks.en: To attenuate staircase artifacts while limiting deformation of unaffected surface regions, we applied the context-aware smoothing method of Mönch et al. (2011) . The method identifies staircase-prone vertices from local variations in incident-face orientation and propagates a distance-dependent smoothing weight over the connected mesh neighborhood. Smoothing is therefore concentrated around detected artifacts rather than applied uniformly to the entire surface.

blocks.en: Spherical parameterization requires a connected, closed, consistently oriented genus- 0 0 surface ( Choi et al., 2015 ) . However, meshes reconstructed from CT-derived lymph node segmentations may contain disconnected components, cavities, handles, or other topological defects. We therefore adapted the voxel-based mesh-repair framework used in previous geometry-image studies ( Sinha et al., 2016 ; Pumarola et al., 2019 ) by introducing an adaptive, natural-first resolution search together with strict topology and mesh-integrity validation.

blocks.en: Although the preceding smoothing and topology correction steps removed major surface irregularities, small localized artifacts could remain without altering the global mesh topology. These defects typically appeared as narrow inward folds, steep-walled pits, or small recessed regions and therefore could not be identified reliably from genus or connectivity alone. We developed a three-stage local detection framework consisting of an initial α \alpha -shape-based candidate localization, followed by complementary ray-based fold detection, local small-hole detection, and CT-informed geometric screening (Fig. 3 ).
blocks.zh: 虽然前面的平滑和地形矫正步骤消除了主要的表面不规则之处,但小的局部文物仍然可能不会改变全球网状地形。 这些缺陷通常作为狭窄的内侧折叠物、陡峭的壁坑或小的凹陷区域出现,因此无法仅从基因或连通性中可靠地识别出来。 我们开发了一个三阶段局部检测框架,其中包括一个初始的α-α-形状候选本地化,然后是互补的射线式折叠检测,局部小孔检测,以及CT知情几何筛选(图3).

blocks.en: A third complementary stage screened residual candidate regions using geometric patterns motivated by common CT-derived surface artifacts, as described in the right panel of Fig. 3 . Four evidence branches were considered: thin opposing surface sheets, local inward recession, risk of opposing-wall merging, and staircase or terrace patterns associated with the through-plane direction ( Cevidanes et al., 2010 ; Ito, 2019 ; Shirshin et al., 2021 ; Mönch et al., 2011 ) .

blocks.en: The selected artifact faces were removed from the source mesh, the unreferenced vertices were discarded, and the local boundary loops were extracted from the edges incident to exactly one retained face. This excision step corresponds to Fig. 4 A. Hole filling followed the standard boundary-triangulation paradigm used in mesh repair ( Liepa, 2003 ) .

blocks.en: For each boundary loop, a best-fitting plane was estimated by singular value decomposition. When the planar projection produced a valid non-self-intersecting polygon, the opening was filled using constrained Delaunay triangulation ( Shewchuk, 1996 ) . If planar triangulation was not admissible because of geometric or connectivity conflicts, a three-dimensional conflict-aware ear-clipping procedure was used instead. blocks.en: After geometric processing and topology validation, each genus- 0 0 lymph node surface was parameterized onto the unit sphere to provide a common domain for subsequent spherical harmonic analysis. Three candidate parameterizations were considered: a spherical conformal map followed by Möbius area correction ( Choi et al., 2015 ; Choi et al., 2020 ) , an area-preserving spherical density-equalizing map initialized from the conformal parameterization ( Lyu et al., 2024 ) , and a spherical Tutte map ( Tutte, 1963 ) included as a robust alternative.

blocks.en: Each candidate mapping was subjected to validity screening according to its parameterization characteristics. blocks.en: To characterize lymph node morphology beyond conventional global shape measurements, geometric descriptors were extracted from the processed reference surfaces and from the SH-reconstructed surfaces. For the multi-resolution analysis, identical feature-extraction procedures and numerical settings were applied independently to the SH reconstructions at different degrees.

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Conventional geometric shape features

blocks.en: Conventional global morphology was characterized using the 14 three-dimensional shape features defined in the PyRadiomics framework ( van Griethuysen et al., 2017 ) . The same descriptors were extracted from the original, processed-reference, and SH-reconstructed surfaces. These features, denoted Py14 , also served as the conventional global-morphology baseline.

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Extended surface descriptors and feature-family organization

blocks.en: Extended descriptors were extracted to characterize complementary aspects of global geometry, local differential geometry, intrinsic spectral geometry, shape distributions, symmetry, and SH spectral organization. The descriptors were organized a priori into 20 geometrically defined feature families (Table 1 ) using established formulations for differential geometry, intrinsic spectral descriptors, geodesic measures, shape distributions, and symmetry ( Meyer et al., 2003 ; Koenderink and van Doorn, 1992 ; Reuter et al., 2006 ; Sun et al., 2009 ; Aubry et al., 2011 ; Crane et al., 2013 ; Osada et al., 2001 ; Kazhdan et al., 2004 ) . The extended set comprised 352 variables; together with Py14 , this yielded 366 candidate variables for multi-resolution analysis.

blocks.en: 3.4 Quantitative evaluation and statistical analysis
blocks.zh: 3.4 定量评价和统计分析

blocks.en: Quantitative analyses evaluated geometric validity, multi-resolution representation, predictive performance, perturbation robustness, and transportability across independent datasets. The complete set of 1,769 1,769 surfaces was used for geometric processing and SH analyses, while predefined subsets were used for computationally intensive paired evaluations as specified below. The independent multicenter lymph node cohort and the LIDC-IDRI lung-nodule cohort were analyzed separately from the primary cohort for label-free external replication and cross-organ validation, respectively.
blocks.zh: 定量分析评价了几何有效性、多分辨率表示、预测性能、扰动强度以及跨独立数据集的可运输性。 完整的1 769 1 769个表面用于几何处理和SH分析,而预先定义的子集用于计算密集的配对评价,具体如下。 对独立的多中心淋巴结组和LIDC-IDRI肺鼻组分别与主组进行了分析,以便进行无标签的外部复制和跨器官验证。

blocks.en: The individual lymph node was the unit of prediction and performance evaluation, whereas the patient was the grouping and resampling unit used to prevent information leakage and account for within-patient dependence. For all predictive analyses, outer and inner cross-validation were performed at the patient level, with all lymph nodes from the same patient assigned to the same fold. Data-dependent preprocessing and hyperparameter selection used training data only, and identical outer partitions were retained for paired model comparisons. For descriptive interpretation of metastasis-associated geometric phenotypes, univariate AUC and Cliff’s δ \delta were additionally used to summarize group separation between metastatic and non-metastatic lymph nodes.
blocks.zh: 单个淋巴结是预测和性能评价的单位,而患者是用于防止信息泄露和说明患者内部依赖性的分组和再取样单位. 在所有预测性分析中,外侧和内侧交叉验证都是在病人一级进行的,同一个病人的所有淋巴结都分配到同一个折叠上. 依赖数据的预处理和超参数选择只使用了培训数据,并保留了相同的外部分区,用于对模型进行比较。 为了描述性地解释与元结构有关的几何形态,还另外使用了Univerariate AUC和Cliff的\\delta来总结元结构和非元结构淋巴结之间的组别。

blocks.en: 3.4.1 Topological validity and downstream computational quality
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 地形学有效性和下游计算质量

blocks.en: Topological validity was evaluated on all 1,769 1,769 surfaces before and after geometric processing using the strict validation criteria defined in Section 2.4 . The primary endpoint was strict topology validity, which required a single connected, closed, consistently oriented genus- 0 0 surface without boundary edges, non-manifold elements, orientation conflicts, duplicate faces, degenerate faces, or unreferenced vertices. Single-component structure, genus- 0 0 topology, and outward orientation were additionally summarized as representative component criteria.

blocks.en: Downstream computational quality was evaluated on a randomly selected fixed subset of 500 500 paired original and processed surfaces using two complementary measures: triangle quality and adjacent-face normal variation. Triangle quality was quantified using the normalized area-based metric defined in Eq. ( 17 ), where values closer to one indicate more equilateral triangles. The reported metric, triangle quality (5th percentile), was defined as the fifth percentile of q i q_{i} over all mesh faces. Adjacent-face normal variation, quantified by the normal jump (95th percentile, degrees), was defined as the area-weighted 95th percentile of dihedral angles between neighboring face normals. Higher triangle quality and lower normal jump indicate improved numerical suitability for subsequent differential-geometric computation.

blocks.en: 3.4.2 Univariate discrimination of conventional shape descriptors
blocks.zh: 3.4.2 传统形状描述符的无差别歧视

blocks.en: To assess whether SH reconstruction altered the discriminative behavior of conventional morphology, each Py14 descriptor was evaluated independently on the original surface and on the six SH reconstructions using a single-feature L2-regularized logistic-regression model. This analysis used 10 repeats of five-fold patient-grouped stratified outer cross-validation, with five-fold patient-grouped inner cross-validation for regularization selection. Identical outer splits were used across descriptors and surface representations, and out-of-fold probabilities were averaged across the 10 repeats before calculation of the final AUC.

blocks.en: 3.4.5 Fixed-resolution and family-specific mixed-resolution prediction
blocks.zh: 3.4.5 固定分辨率和针对家庭的混合分辨率预测

blocks.en: Predictive modeling was performed on all 1,769 1,769 lymph nodes from 214 214 patients. At each fixed SH degree, all 366 366 candidate variables from the 20 predefined feature families were used to construct a fixed-resolution model. A family-specific mixed-resolution model was constructed to allow each feature family to select its preferred SH degree using training data only.
blocks.zh: 对214 214名病人的所有1 769 1 769个淋巴结进行了预测性建模。 在每一固定的SH度,20个预先界定的特性家族的所有366 366个候选变量都用于构建一个固定分辨率模型。 设计了一个针对家庭的混合分辨率模型,使每个特征家庭能够仅利用培训数据选择其首选的SH学位。

blocks.en: All headline models used three repeats of five-fold patient-grouped stratified outer cross-validation, with identical outer partitions locked across all SH degrees and model comparisons. Within each outer training set, five-fold patient-grouped stratified inner cross-validation was used for degree selection and regularization tuning. The modeling pipeline consisted of median imputation with missing-value indicators, feature standardization, and class-balanced L2-regularized logistic regression. The regularization parameter was selected from C ∈ { 0.01 , 0.1 , 1 , 10 , 100 } C\in\{0.01,0.1,1,10,100\} according to mean inner-cross-validation AUC.
blocks.zh: 所有头条模型都使用了3个重复的5倍患者分组分层的外侧交叉验证,在所有SH度上锁定相同的外侧分区,模型比较. 在每套外部训练中,有5倍的病人分组分层进行内部交叉验证,用于学位选择和正规化调整。 建模管道由中位值估算和缺失值指标、特征标准化以及L2类平衡的正常物流回归组成。 规范化参数选自C {{ 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100} C\in} 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100}, 以内- 校验 ACUC 的平均值表示.

Confidence intervals and paired model differences were estimated using 2,000 stratified patient-cluster bootstrap resamples, with patients serving as the resampling units and all lymph nodes from each selected patient retained jointly.

blocks.en: The original-surface Py14 model was evaluated on 1,769 lymph nodes from 214 patients as the conventional global-morphology baseline. Its lymph-node-level out-of-fold predictions were compared with those of the mixed-resolution model using paired bootstrap resampling.

blocks.en: 3.5 Resolution-dependent perturbation robustness
blocks.zh: 3.5 依赖分辨率的干扰力

blocks.en: To investigate how SH resolution affects sensitivity to small geometric variation, we performed a controlled perturbation analysis at geometric, harmonic, and predictive levels. A single perturbation realization was generated for each processed lymph node surface and propagated through all six SH reconstruction degrees: L ∈ { 5 , 8 , 10 , 15 , 20 , 34 } L\in\{5,8,10,15,20,34\} . Complete paired data were available for a randomly selected subset of 324 324 lymph-node surfaces throughout the robustness analysis. Each degree retained its own degree-specific spherical parameterization selected from the corresponding clean surface; therefore, between-degree differences reflect the combined behavior of the lower- or higher-resolution SH representation and its clean-selected mapping, rather than spectral truncation alone.

blocks.en: 3.6 Independent external and cross-organ validation
blocks.zh: 3.6 独立的外部和跨机构验证

blocks.en: 3.6.1 Multicenter label-free lymph node replication
blocks.zh: 3.6.1 多中心无标签淋巴结复制

blocks.en: All 2,644 external-cohort surfaces underwent the complete preprocessing pipeline and shape analysis described previously (Sections 2 and 3 ), as well as topology validation (Section 3.4.1 ). Subsequently, a simple random sample of 1,000 topology-eligible lymph nodes was drawn without replacement for the computational tests described in Section 3.4.1 . The external replication analysis of degree-dependent feature effects was conducted separately using the complete cohort of 2,644 lymph nodes.
blocks.zh: 所有2 644个外走廊表面都经过了前述(第2和第3节)的完整预处理管道和形状分析以及地形验证(第3.4.1节)。 随后,抽取了1,000个符合地形条件的淋巴结的简单随机样本,但没有替换第3.4.1节所述的计算测试。 对学位依赖特征效应的外部复制分析是利用2 644个淋巴结的完整组别单独进行的。

blocks.en: Because pathological labels were unavailable, the external cohort was used to test replication of degree-dependent geometric effects rather than clinical prediction performance.
blocks.zh: 由于病理学标签不可用,外部组群被用于测试学位依赖几何效应的复制,而不是临床预测性能.

blocks.en: The internal cohort comprised 1,769 lymph nodes from 214 unique patients. All lymph nodes from the same patient were assigned to the same cross-validation fold and were resampled jointly in patient-level bootstrap analyses. The analysis was restricted a priori to the three geometric feature families available in both cohorts: convexity (6 features), mean curvature (26 features), and central asymmetry (10 features). SH-energy features were not included because the corresponding feature set was not available for matched external replication.
blocks.zh: 内部组群包括来自214名独特患者的1,769个淋巴结。 同一患者的所有淋巴结都被分配到相同的交叉验证折叠上,并在患者级的靴子链分析中被联合复制. 分析先验限于两个组群中可用的三个几何特征家族:对流(6个特征)、平均曲率(26个特征)和中央不对称(10个特征)。 不包括SH-能量特性,因为相应的特性集没有可供匹配的外部复制.

blocks.en: The degree set was fixed before examination of the external cohort. It was selected to cover the dominant family-specific degrees identified in the leakage-safe internal model-selection analysis: L = 5 L=5 for convexity, L = 10 L=10 for mean curvature, and L = 34 L=34 for central asymmetry. In the internal analysis, degree selection was performed using inner-cross-validation AUC within each outer training fold; these values were the modal selected degrees for their respective feature families. To enable matched cross-cohort evaluation, all three feature families were recomputed at each of the common degrees, L = 5 L=5 , L = 10 L=10 , and L = 34 L=34 , in both cohorts. The external cohort was therefore used to assess replication of prespecified degree-dependent geometric signatures rather than to re-select an optimal degree.
blocks.zh: 在对外部群体进行检查之前,已经确定了学位设置。 选用它来涵盖在防渗漏的内部模型选择分析中确定的主要家族特有度:L=5L=5对对流,L=10L=10对平均曲率,L=34L=34对中心不对称. 在内部分析中,在每套外部训练材料中,使用内部交叉验证AUC进行学位选择;这些数值是各自特征家族选取的模式学位。 为了实现匹配的交叉曲线评价,所有三个特征家族在每组常见的学位中,L=5L=5,L=10L=10,L=34L=34。 因此,外部组别被用来评估预先指定的学位依赖几何特征的复制情况,而不是重新选择最佳学位。

blocks.en: Within each cohort, measurements obtained at different reconstruction degrees were treated as repeated observations from the same lymph node. For each feature with complete measurements at all three degrees, an omnibus Friedman test was used to assess degree dependence. Pairwise degree effects were estimated for the three prespecified contrasts: L = 5 L=5 versus L = 10 L=10 , L = 10 L=10 versus L = 34 L=34 , and L = 5 L=5 versus L = 34 L=34 , using two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. For each contrast, the paired difference was defined as the value at the first degree minus the value at the second degree. Effect magnitude and direction were summarized using the rank-biserial correlation. Median paired differences were accompanied by 95% percentile bootstrap confidence intervals based on 10,000 resamples. Benjamini–Hochberg false-discovery-rate correction was applied separately within each cohort across the feature-level omnibus tests and across the pairwise tests.
blocks.zh: 在每个组别中,在不同重建度获得的测量数据作为同一淋巴结的重复观测数据处理。 对于每个具有所有三度完全测量特征的特征,都采用了综合的弗里德曼测试来评估学位依赖性. 三种预测对比的对等度效应估计为:L=5 L=5对L=10 L=10,L=10 L=10对L=34 L=34,L=5 L=5对L=34 L,采用双侧威尔科森签名排名测试. 每种对比值,对位差被定义为第一度值减去第二度值. 利用等级-二等关系总结了影响大小和方向。 中间配对差异伴随着95%的靴套置信间隔,基于10,000个复刻。 Benjamini-Hochberg假发现率校正在特征级综合测试和对等测试的每个组别中分别适用。

blocks.en: Each internal degree effect was matched to its external counterpart by feature family, feature identity, and degree contrast. Concordance between the internal and external rank-biserial effect sizes was quantified using Spearman’s correlation coefficient, with 95% percentile bootstrap confidence intervals obtained from 10,000 resamples of the matched effect pairs. Directional replication was summarized as the proportion of matched non-zero effects having the same sign in both cohorts; a two-sided exact binomial test against a probability of 0.5 was used as a supplementary assessment. Family-specific concordance analyses were considered primary, whereas the pooled analysis across all matched effects was considered secondary because the three families contributed unequal numbers of effects. This feature-level replication framework was consistent with established approaches for assessing replicability across multiple features while controlling multiplicity ( Bogomolov and Heller, 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 每个内部学位效应都通过特征家族、特征身份和学位对比与外部对应效应相匹配。 用斯皮尔曼的关联系数对内外级-二等效应大小之间的一致进行了量化,从对应效应对的1万个复标中获得了95%的靴套置信间隔。 定向复制被总结为两个组别中具有相同标志的匹配非零效应的比例;对概率为0.5的双侧精确二元测试作为补充评估。 具体家庭的和谐分析被认为是首要的,而对所有相应效果的集合分析则被认为是次要的,因为这三个家庭产生的效果数量不平等。 这个特征层面的复制框架符合既定的跨多个特征的可复制性评估方法,同时控制多重性(Bogomolov and Heller, 2018).

blocks.en: 3.6.2 Cross-organ validation in LIDC-IDRI lung nodules
blocks.zh: 3.6.2 LIDC-IDRI肺结核的跨部门鉴定

blocks.en: The LIDC-IDRI cohort was analyzed as an independent cross-organ experiment to determine whether the resolution-dependent relationship between SH representation and downstream discriminative performance extended beyond axillary lymph node morphology. SH-based three-dimensional shape analysis has previously been applied to lung-nodule malignancy discrimination ( El-Baz et al., 2011 ) ; here, the purpose of the LIDC-IDRI experiment was specifically to evaluate whether predictive performance remained dependent on SH reconstruction resolution in a distinct anatomical structure and classification task. For the supervised classification task, only nodules with definite diagnostic labels were considered. Label 1 nodules (benign/non-malignant) and label 2 nodules (primary malignant) were retained, whereas label 0 nodules with unknown diagnosis and label 3 metastatic lesions were excluded to maintain a clinically well-defined binary classification task. After further requiring usable CT data and corresponding segmentation contours suitable for three-dimensional surface reconstruction, 59 lung nodules from 56 unique patients were retained for analysis. Of these, 50 satisfied the strict topological criteria before geometric processing, while all 59 were retained for application of the complete preprocessing pipeline.
blocks.zh: LIDC-IDRI组群被分析为一个独立的跨组织实验,以确定SH代表与下游歧视性表现之间的分辨率依赖关系是否延伸到轴淋巴结形态之外. 以SH为基础的三维形状分析以前曾应用于肺-结核恶性歧视(El-Baz等人,2011年);在此,LIDC-IDRI实验的目的专门是评价预测性能是否仍然取决于SH重建分辨率在明显的解剖结构和分类任务中. 就监督的分类任务而言,只考虑有明确诊断标签的结核。 1号标签结核(原生/非原生)和2号标签结核(主要恶性)被保留,而0号标签结核的诊断和3号标签的元病变则被排除,以维持临床上定义明确的二进制分类任务。 在进一步需要可用的CT数据和适合三维表面重建的相应分块轮廓之后,保留了来自56个独特病人的59个肺结核以供分析。 其中,50个在几何处理前满足了严格的地形标准,而所有59个则被保留用于应用完整的预处理管道.

blocks.en: Following geometric processing and spherical parameterization, each lung-nodule surface was reconstructed using the prespecified SH degrees L ∈ { 5 , 10 , 20 , 30 , 40 , 50 } L\in\{5,10,20,30,40,50\} . Degree-specific representations were generated independently using the SH reconstruction framework described in Section 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 经过几何处理和球形参数化后,每个肺-鼻部表面采用预先指定的SH度L { 5,10,20,30,40,50}重建. L\in 5,10,20,30,40,50}. 学位特定表述是利用第3.2节所述的SH重建框架独立生成的。

blocks.en: For each SH degree, the same predefined feature-extraction procedure was applied to three geometric feature families: convexity, mean curvature, and central asymmetry. Degree-specific classifiers followed the same preprocessing and L2-regularized logistic-regression framework described in Section 3.4.5 , with identical feature definitions and data partitions across all six degrees. Thus, SH reconstruction degree was the principal experimental factor differing among the compared representations.
blocks.zh: 对于每个SH学位,对三个几何特征家族采用了相同的预定义的特征提取程序:对流,平均曲率,以及中心不对称. 学位特定分类人员采用第3.4.5节所述的同样的预处理和L2-正规后勤后退框架,所有六个度都有相同的特征定义和数据分区。 因此,SH重建学位是比较表述的不同的主要实验因素。

blocks.en: Predictive performance was evaluated using five-fold outer cross-validation repeated three times, with all nodules from the same patient assigned to the same fold. Within each outer training set, the regularization parameter was selected by three-fold inner patient-grouped cross-validation using the same candidate grid described in Section 3.4.5 . Identical outer partitions were retained across all six SH degrees.
blocks.zh: 对预测性能进行了评价,利用5倍的外交叉验证重复了3次,同一病人的所有结核都被分配到同一折叠上。 在每套外部训练中,规范化参数由三倍的内侧患者分组交叉验证方法使用第3.4.5节描述的同一候选网格选择. 在所有六个SH度都保留了同样的外部分隔。

blocks.en: Out-of-fold probabilities from the three outer-cross-validation repeats were averaged for each nodule. For each SH degree, discriminative performance was summarized using the area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (AUC). Ninety-five percent confidence intervals were estimated using 2,000 bootstrap resamples of the averaged out-of-fold predictions. Degree-specific AUC differences were assessed using paired bootstrap resampling with 2,000 iterations.
blocks.zh: 每种结核平均有三次外交叉验证重复产生的双重概率。 对于每一SH学位,使用接收-操作-特征曲线(AUC)下的区域对歧视性表现进行总结。 95%的置信间隔是使用2,000个靴子重新标出平均值的预测。 使用2 000个迭代的配对靴子重新取样,对特定学位的甲型六氯环己烷差异进行了评估。

blocks.en: This cross-organ replication analysis evaluated whether the resolution-dependent relationship between SH representation and predictive performance generalized to a distinct anatomical structure and classification task.
blocks.zh: 这种跨机构复制分析评价了SH代表与预测性能之间的分辨率依赖关系是否被普遍归纳到一个独特的解剖结构和分类任务中.

blocks.en: 4.2.4 Feature-dependent SH resolution preferences
blocks.zh: 4.2.4 依赖特性的SH分辨率偏好

blocks.en: The preferred SH degree varied substantially across the predefined geometric feature families (Fig. 8 ). Many curvature-related, spectral-energy, and shape-distribution descriptors favored intermediate resolutions, whereas several global and intrinsic descriptors favored lower degrees and selected families favored the highest resolution. These heterogeneous selection patterns demonstrate that the reconstruction scale most informative for prediction depends on the geometric quantity being measured.

blocks.en: 4.2.5 High-resolution SH achieves compact geometric representation with high fidelity
blocks.zh: 4.2.5 高分辨率SH实现高度忠诚的紧凑几何表示

blocks.en: Despite its lower predictive utility relative to intermediate resolutions, degree 34 34 provided the closest approximation to the processed reference geometry. In the 500 500 -lymph-node fidelity subset, the median normalized symmetric mean nearest-neighbor distance and HD95 were 0.00887 and 0.01744, respectively, while relative surface-area and volume errors were 0.120% and 0.006%. Agreement of the 14 Py14 descriptors with the reference surfaces was also high (median Pearson, Spearman, and Lin’s concordance correlations: 0.9995, 0.9999, and 0.9995). A degree- 34 34 representation used 1,225 1,225 three-dimensional coefficient vectors compared with a median of 38,492 38,492 mesh vertices, corresponding to a 31.42-fold reduction in representation elements. Thus, high-resolution SH remained useful when faithful and structured geometric representation, rather than maximal discrimination, was the primary objective.
blocks.zh: 尽管与中间分辨率相比,预测效用较低,但第34度提供了与已处理的参考几何学最接近的近似值。 在500-淋巴-节点忠诚子集中,正中对称的近邻平均距离和HD95分别为0.00887和0.01744,相对的表面积和体积误差分别为0.20%和0.006。 14个Py14描述符与参考面的一致度也很高(中间派尔森,斯皮尔曼,和林的协和关系:0.9995,0.9999,和0.9995). 一种度-34 34 表示法使用了1,225,225个三维系数矢量,而中位数为38,492,38,492个网顶,相当于表示要素的31.42倍减少. 因此,当忠诚和结构化的几何代表性,而不是最大程度的歧视成为主要目标时,高分辨率的SH仍然有用。

blocks.en: 4.3 Resolution-dependent perturbation robustness
blocks.zh: 4.3 依赖分辨率的干扰力

blocks.en: Geometric perturbation transmission increased with SH degree (Fig. 9 A), with the median transmission ratio rising from T 5 = 0.794 T_{5}=0.794 to T 34 = 0.992 T_{34}=0.992 . Thus, progressively higher-resolution representations retained a larger fraction of the imposed surface displacement.

blocks.en: The harmonic-domain analysis showed the same resolution dependence. Cumulative retained perturbation energy increased with truncation degree (Fig. 9 B), while the perturbation-to-clean energy ratio exceeded unity from approximately the intermediate harmonic range and remained elevated at high degrees (Fig. 9 C). These results indicate that increasing SH bandwidth retains progressively more perturbation energy and increases its relative contribution at fine spectral scales.

blocks.en: The same pattern propagated to curvature-based prediction (Fig. 9 D). blocks.en: 4.4 Metastasis-associated geometric phenotypes
blocks.zh: 4.4 与Metastasis有关的几何酚类

blocks.en: Beyond aggregate model performance, representative descriptors from the interpretable geometric families showed substantial separation between metastatic and non-metastatic lymph nodes. The strongest examples included lower-tail curvedness and absolute mean-curvature descriptors, Gaussian-curvature statistics, radial morphology, and convexity-related measurements, with univariate AUCs ranging from 0.824 to 0.898. The corresponding Cliff’s δ \delta values indicated large effect sizes across both global and local geometric properties.
blocks.zh: 除了总体模型性能外,来自可解释几何系的代表性描述符显示,元静态与非元静态淋巴节点之间有很大的分离。 最强的例子包括下尾曲线和绝对平均曲线描述符,高斯曲线统计法,射线形态法,和对流相关的测量法,无偏差的AUC从0.824到0.898. Cliff对应的\\delta值表明,全球和局部几何特性的效应都很大。

blocks.en: These descriptors characterize different manifestations of the nodal surface phenotype. Radial and convexity-related measurements quantify departures from a regular overall contour, whereas curvedness and curvature statistics capture regional variations in surface bending and contour irregularity. Such geometric changes may be consistent with structural remodeling accompanying metastatic involvement, including asymmetric cortical thickening, hilar effacement, or heterogeneous tumor infiltration, which can alter the external contour of the lymph node. Their joint association with metastatic status therefore suggests that relevant morphological information extends beyond global enlargement or compactness to include spatially heterogeneous surface remodeling. Together, these measurements provide an interpretable quantitative description of metastasis-associated nodal morphology complementary to conventional global radiomic shape features.
blocks.zh: 这些描述词对节点表型的不同表现进行了描述. 与辐射和对流有关的测量量化了与正常整体轮廓的偏离,而曲线和曲率统计则记录了地表弯曲和轮廓不规则的区域变化。 这种几何变化可能与伴随的元静态参与的结构重塑相一致,包括不对称皮层增厚,耳光擦除,或异质肿瘤渗透,这可以改变淋巴结的外部轮廓. 因此,它们与元静态的联合关系表明,相关的形态学信息超越了全球扩展或紧凑的范围,包括了空间多样性的表面改造。 这些测量一起提供了可解释的定量描述,说明与传统全球放射形状特征相配合的元结构节点形态。

blocks.en: 4.5 Independent external and cross-organ validation
blocks.zh: 4.5 独立的外部和跨机构验证

blocks.en: 4.5.1 Multicenter label-free lymph node replication
blocks.zh: 4.5.1 多中心无标签淋巴结复制

blocks.en: The multicenter external cohort comprised 2,644 lymph nodes without node-level pathological metastasis labels and was used to assess label-free replication of the geometric-processing and family-specific degree effects.
blocks.zh: 多中心外部组群包括2,644个淋巴结,没有节点级病理元化标签,用于评估无标签复制几何处理和家族特异学位效应。

blocks.en: Geometric processing established complete strict topology validity in both independent datasets (Table 5 ). All 2,644 multicenter lymph node surfaces and all 59 LIDC-IDRI lung-nodule surfaces satisfied the predefined topological requirements after processing, with a larger pre-processing deficit observed in the LIDC-IDRI cohort.

blocks.en: Computational-quality measures also improved substantially after geometric processing in both independent datasets (Table 6 ). Processing increased lower-tail triangle quality and markedly reduced extreme adjacent-face normal variation in both the multicenter lymph node and LIDC-IDRI cohorts, indicating improved mesh regularity across distinct anatomical datasets.
blocks.zh: 在两个独立数据集进行几何处理后,计算质量计量也大有改进(表6)。 在多中心淋巴节点和LIDC-IDRI组别中,加工提高了下尾三角形质量,并显著降低了极近面的正常差异,表明不同解剖数据集的网格周期性有所改进。

Their internally specified preferred degrees were L = 5 L=5 , L = 10 L=10 , and L = 34 L=34 , respectively. All three families were therefore recomputed at the common degrees L = 5 L=5 , L = 10 L=10 , and L = 34 L=34 in both cohorts.

blocks.en: Together, these results support the transportability of the geometric-processing framework and the family-specific multi-resolution effects to the independent multicenter lymph node cohort.

blocks.en: 4.5.2 Family-specific favored SH degrees in LIDC-IDRI lung nodules
blocks.zh: 4.5.2 LIDC-IDRI肺结核中家庭特有SH学位

Convexity achieved its highest observed AUC at L = 5 L=5 , whereas mean curvature and central asymmetry favored L = 40 L=40 and L = 30 L=30 , respectively. Despite the distinct anatomy and classification endpoint, predictive utility therefore remained resolution-dependent, and the favored degree varied across feature families.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: This study shows that SH degree should be interpreted as a task-dependent geometric scale rather than a resolution parameter to be maximized uniformly. Across geometric fidelity, metastasis discrimination, perturbation robustness, and cross-organ prediction, different analytical objectives and anatomical settings favored different spectral resolutions.
blocks.zh: 这项研究显示,SH学位应该被解释为一个依赖于任务的几何尺度,而不是一个需要统一最大化的分辨率参数. 纵观几何忠诚、元固态歧视、扰动强性、跨器官预测、不同的分析目标和解剖环境,都倾向于不同的光谱分辨率。

blocks.en: 5.1 Reliable surface representation enables quantitative geometric analysis
blocks.zh: 5.1 可靠的表面表层能进行定量几何分析

blocks.en: The increase in strict topology validity to 100%, together with the marked improvement in triangle regularity and adjacent-face normal consistency, demonstrates that preprocessing is not merely a cosmetic smoothing step but establishes the computational domain required for subsequent spherical and differential-geometric analysis. This distinction is important because a nominal genus- 0 0 classification alone does not guarantee the connectedness, manifoldness, orientation consistency, or local numerical regularity required by geometric operators ( Brechbühler et al., 1995 ; Choi et al., 2015 ; Meyer et al., 2003 ) . The reproduction of these improvements in the independent multicenter cohort further indicates that the processing procedure was not specific to the internal data source.
blocks.zh: 严格的地形有效性提高到100%,加上三角规律和相邻面正常一致性的明显改善,表明预处理不仅仅是一个化妆品平滑步骤,还确立了后续球面和差分几何分析所需的计算领域. 这种区分很重要,因为单是名义上的基因-0分类并不能保证几何操作者所要求的连接性,多元性,定向一致性,或本地数字规律性(Brechbühler等人,1995年;Choi等人,2015年;Meyer等人,2003年)。 在独立的多中心组中复制这些改进进一步表明,处理程序并非专门针对内部数据源。

blocks.en: 5.2 SH resolution defines a task-dependent geometric scale
blocks.zh: 5.2 SH分辨率定义了依赖于任务的几何尺度

blocks.en: The divergence between reconstruction fidelity and discrimination is central to the interpretation of SH resolution. Increasing degree systematically improved geometric recovery, as expected from the hierarchical structure of the SH basis ( Kazhdan et al., 2003 ) , but the strongest metastatic-status discrimination occurred at intermediate resolutions. High-frequency geometric content therefore cannot be assumed to be uniformly task-informative. In this setting, spectral truncation is better interpreted as scale selection than as simple information loss: low degrees may omit disease-associated regional morphology, whereas high degrees may increasingly retain fine contour variations arising from both anatomy and image- or segmentation-related variability. Intermediate resolutions may consequently provide a more favorable balance between morphological information and fine-scale uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 重建忠贞和歧视之间的分歧是解释自助解决办法的核心。 根据SH基础的等级结构(Kazhdan等人,2003年)的预期,几何恢复程度得到系统性的提高,但中间分辨率中却出现了最强的元结构歧视。 因此,不能认为高频几何含量具有统一的任务参考性。 在这种环境下,光谱切变被解释为尺度选择比简单的信息损失要好:低度可能省略与疾病相关的区域形态,而高度则可能越来越多地保留由解剖学和图像或分解相关的可变性所产生的细微的轮廓变化. 因此,中间决议可能在形态信息和细度不确定性之间提供更有利的平衡。

blocks.en: The preferred scale also depended on the geometric quantity being measured. Global morphology, curvature, intrinsic geometry, spatial distributions, and symmetry characterize different aspects of surface organization and therefore need not respond similarly to spectral bandwidth. Accordingly, the family-specific selection results support incorporating representation scale into feature construction rather than imposing a single global reconstruction degree. The mixed-resolution model was comparable to the best intermediate fixed-degree models, suggesting that family-specific selection primarily avoids mismatched representation scales across heterogeneous geometric measurements.
blocks.zh: 首选的尺度还取决于所测量的几何数量。 全球形态学,曲率学,内在几何,空间分布,以及对称性,都对地表组织的不同方面具有特征,因此不需要对光谱带宽作出类似反应. 因此,针对特定家庭的甄选结果支持将代表人数表纳入特色建筑,而不是强加单一的全球重建程度。 混合分辨率模型可与最佳中间固定度模型相比,这表明针对具体家庭的选择主要避免了不同几何测量中代表比例的不匹配。

blocks.en: Previous medical applications have demonstrated the utility of SH-derived shape information for lung-nodule and cardiac classification ( El-Baz et al., 2011 ; Valizadeh et al., 2021 ) . The LIDC-IDRI experiment extended this observation to a distinct anatomical structure and classification task. Despite substantial differences between lung nodules and axillary lymph nodes, predictive performance remained dependent on SH reconstruction degree. These results further support a task-dependent interpretation of spectral resolution, with the preferred bandwidth potentially varying with anatomy, feature definition, and downstream objective.
blocks.zh: 以往的医疗应用证明,SH衍生的形状信息对肺结核和心脏分类很有用(El-Baz等人,2011年;Valizadeh等人,2021年)。 LIDC-IDRI实验将这一观测扩展至一个独特的解剖结构和分类任务. 尽管肺结核和轴淋巴结之间存在很大差异,预测性能仍取决于SH重建程度。 这些结果进一步支持根据任务对光谱分辨率进行解释,首选带宽可能随解剖学、特征定义和下游目标而变化。

blocks.en: 5.3 Resolution-dependent perturbation sensitivity and the fidelity–robustness trade-off
blocks.zh: 5.3 依赖分辨率的扰动敏感度和忠诚度-风险权衡

blocks.en: The perturbation experiments provide a complementary explanation for the resolution-dependent behavior of SH representations. Spectral truncation attenuated a larger fraction of the imposed geometric variation at lower degrees, whereas higher degrees preserved progressively more of the perturbation in both the reconstructed geometry and harmonic coefficients. The same trend propagated to curvature-derived predictions, whose stability decreased as resolution increased. Because local differential quantities are particularly responsive to fine-scale surface variation, the additional bandwidth that improves high-resolution geometric fidelity can simultaneously increase sensitivity to perturbations.
blocks.zh: 扰动实验为SH表达的依赖分辨率的行为提供了补充解释. 光谱截断在较低度减轻了较大比例的硬化几何变异,而较高度在重建几何和谐振系数中逐渐保留了更多的扰动。 同样的趋势传播到曲率预测,其稳定性随着分辨率的增加而降低。 由于局部的差分量对细度的表面变异反应特别强,因此增加的带宽能提高高分辨率几何忠诚度,可以同时提高扰动的敏感性.

blocks.en: Higher geometric fidelity and lower perturbation attenuation are two consequences of increased representational bandwidth. Preserving finer geometry necessarily reduces spectral suppression of small-scale variation. Consequently, the appropriate SH degree depends on both the level of geometric detail to be retained and the stability requirements of the downstream measurement.
blocks.zh: 几何忠诚度较高和扰动减弱程度较低是增加代表带宽的两个后果。 保存更细的几何学必然会减少小尺度变异的光谱抑制. 因此,适当的SH度取决于保留几何细节的水平和下游测量的稳定性要求。

blocks.en: 5.4 Limitations and future directions
blocks.zh: 5.4 限制和未来方向

blocks.en: The present framework has two main limitations. First, it relies on the fidelity of CT-derived surface reconstruction. Finite spatial resolution, anisotropic sampling, partial-volume effects, and segmentation variability may introduce geometric uncertainty that cannot be fully separated from true anatomical variation. This issue is particularly relevant for curvature-based descriptors, which are sensitive to local geometric perturbations and discretization effects ( Meyer et al., 2003 ; Gatzke and Grimm, 2006 ) . Although the proposed preprocessing improves mesh validity and numerical stability, it cannot recover anatomical information absent from the original imaging data.
blocks.zh: 目前的框架有两个主要的局限性。 首先,它依赖于CT衍生的地面重建的忠实性。 有限的空间分辨率、异位采样、部分量效应和分解变异性可能带来几何不确定性,不能与真正的解剖变异完全分开。 这一问题与曲率描述符特别相关,这些描述符对当地几何扰动和盘状效应十分敏感(Meyer等人,2003年;Gatzke和Grimm,2006年)。 尽管拟议的预处理提高了网目有效性和数值稳定性,但无法从原始成像数据中恢复解剖信息。

blocks.en: Second, SH degree selection provides only an indirect mechanism for controlling the trade-off between geometric fidelity and robustness. Lower-degree representations suppress high-frequency variations but may remove informative geometry, whereas multi-resolution representations increase computational cost. Future work should investigate differential-response-based representations that directly characterize and regulate the sensitivity of geometric measurements to surface perturbations.
blocks.zh: 第二,SH学位选择只提供了一种间接机制,用以控制几何忠诚度和稳健度之间的权衡. 低度表示抑制高频变化,但可能消除信息几何,而多分辨率表示则增加计算成本。 今后的工作应调查直接描述和规范几何测量对地表扰动的敏感性的差别反应表示。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We developed an integrated framework for topology-aware processing and multi-resolution geometric analysis of CT-derived axillary lymph node surfaces. The proposed processing pipeline established a connected, closed, consistently oriented genus- 0 0 computational domain for spherical analysis while improving local mesh quality and limiting unnecessary modification of the underlying geometry. This provides a reproducible geometric basis for applying differential-geometric and spectral descriptors to clinically derived three-dimensional surfaces.
blocks.zh: 我们为CT衍生的轴突淋巴结表面的地形意识处理和多分辨率几何分析制定了一个综合框架。 拟议的加工管道建立了一个连接的、封闭的、始终如一的基因0计算域,用于球面分析,同时提高局部网状质量,限制对基本几何进行不必要的修改。 这为临床上得出的三维表面应用差分几何和光谱描述符提供了可复制的几何基础.

blocks.en: The principal finding is that SH resolution should be regarded as a task-dependent geometric scale rather than as a reconstruction parameter that should be maximized uniformly. Increasing SH degree progressively improved reconstruction fidelity, but metastasis-associated discrimination was strongest at intermediate spectral scales, and different geometric feature families favored different resolutions. The family-specific mixed-resolution representation accommodated these heterogeneous scale preferences and captured discriminative information beyond conventional global shape descriptors, while high-resolution SH remained valuable for compact and faithful representation of detailed surface geometry. Thus, the resolution that best preserves the observed surface need not be the resolution that is most informative for a downstream prediction task.
blocks.zh: 主要结论是,SH分辨率应被视为一个依赖于任务的几何尺度,而不是一个应当统一优化的重建参数。 不断提高SH度逐渐提高重建忠贞度,但在中间光谱尺度上与元化相关的歧视最为强烈,不同的几何特征家庭倾向于不同的分辨率。 家庭特异性混合分辨率代表适应了这些不同比例的偏好,收集了超出传统全球形状描述符的歧视性信息,而高分辨率的SH仍然对清晰和忠实地反映详细的表面几何特征很有价值。 因此,最能保护所观测到的表面的决议不一定是下游预测任务最翔实的决议。

blocks.en: Controlled perturbation analysis further showed that SH resolution also governs the transmission of fine-scale geometric variation: higher-degree representations preserved a larger fraction of the imposed perturbation, whereas spectral truncation provided greater attenuation and correspondingly greater stability of curvature-based predictions. Together, these findings distinguish geometric fidelity, discriminative utility, and perturbation robustness as complementary but non-equivalent objectives of quantitative shape representation. The proposed framework therefore provides a principled basis for selecting geometric resolution according to the downstream analytical objective and offers a general strategy for multi-scale quantitative characterization of lymph node morphology and other clinically derived three-dimensional anatomical surfaces.
blocks.zh: 受控扰动分析进一步表明,SH分辨率也制约着微尺度几何变异的传播:更高度的表示保留了所施加扰动的较大比例,而光谱截断则为曲率预测提供了更大的减弱和相应的稳定性。 这些结论共同将几何忠诚、歧视性效用和扰动强性区分为定量形态代表性的补充但非等同的目标。 因此,拟议框架为根据下游分析目标选择几何分辨率提供了原则基础,并为淋巴节点形态和其他临床衍生的三维解剖面的多尺度定量定性提供了总体战略.
